name: Sword Health
description: Sword Health is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and funds that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Sword Health is a privately held digital health company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $40 million funding round announced on June 17, 2025, valued the company at $4 billion.

Based in New York, Sword Health provides virtual care for physical pain, pelvic health and mental health, delivered through AI software working alongside licensed clinicians. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Holdings reported by a registered fund (June 30, 2026)
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. The 2024 amount excludes $100 million of employee shares sold to investors in a secondary sale, and the Series D valuation reflects a $26 million secondary sale that followed the round.
round_notes: General Catalyst led the June 2025 round. In January 2026, Bloomberg reported that Sword Health was seeking to raise $500 million as it agreed to acquire Kaia Health for $285 million. Sword Health has not announced a further round.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: General Catalyst led the June 2025 round, with participation from Khosla Ventures, Comcast Ventures, Lince Capital, Oxy Capital, Armilar, Indico Capital and Shilling. Sapphire Ventures led the Series D in November 2021. Other investors include Founders Fund, Bond, Transformation Capital, ADQ and LocalGlobe.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Sword Health appear in SEC Form D filings.
funds: One SEC-registered fund reports a position in Sword Health. Partners Group Growth, LLC valued its holdings at $7.6 million as of June 30, 2026.
sources: Sources: Sword Health's announcement dated June 17, 2025; TechCrunch reports dated June 17, 2025 and June 4, 2024; Goodwin's notice of the Series D (December 2021); reports by Bloomberg (November 2021 and January 2026); and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
